lines.2: We all gathered in the student council room.
lines.3: 「Mm-hmm. Now that the full team is here, it's quite a sight. We certainly look like a team known for individual skill and offensive power.」
lines.5: 「That's not true. We understand each other perfectly. Why, I even know how many moles Yoppi has on her body.」
lines.6: 「And I know Leo's ticklish. His sides are a fatal weak point.」
lines.8: 「If I can't sleep and call Yoppi at three in the morning, she stays up and talks to me.」
lines.9: 「Leo levels up my RPG characters while I'm asleep!」
lines.10: 「Because you keep charging ahead when you're underleveled.」
lines.11: 「This is a difficult contest to judge.」
lines.12: 「Why are you two even competing? Honestly.」
lines.13: 「...If there isn't any work, I'm going home.」
